title: Results from Saturday's events are not online yet
detail: Limitless still lists nothing for Pokémon Special Event Buenos Aires (14 Nov) or the One Piece regionals of 7 and 14 Nov; its One Piece list still ends 26 Jul. Winners stay unconfirmed. Next up: Pokémon Latin America Internationals, São Paulo, 20–22 Nov.

title: OP-18 date: English 20 Nov, Japan 21 Nov (not 22 Nov)
detail: Bandai's English event page runs the OP-18 release events from 20 Nov to 17 Dec. The 20 Nov English and 21 Nov Japanese dates come from secondary sites quoting the product pages, so this corrects yesterday's 22 Nov note but is still not read directly from Bandai. French date still unconfirmed.
source: Bandai EN event page; Samurai Sword Tokyo (secondary)

title: Réunion: Miyata Kard Market lists a Delta Reign second wave for 17 Nov
detail: Page shows 'Arrivage prévu le 17/11/2026' on the Tripack (€19.99), Elite Trainer Box (€79.99), 6-booster Bundle (€44.99) and 36-booster display (€239.99); all but the Bundle read 'Épuisé'. Stock labels on the page conflict, so check before travelling.

title: Price check: still no 20% moves
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket 7-day vs 30-day averages: Mew ex 152 €82.27 vs €87.75 (−6%); Gengar ex 154 €62.47 vs €66.64 (−6%); Pikachu ex 150 €50.23 vs €53.28 (−6%). Same as yesterday, nothing to act on.
